title: R2004 DWG decompressor extended-length overflow fast slice
mode: Generated local regression and bounded implementation
scope: Reproduce arithmetic overflow in AC1018/R2004 extended copy lengths.
Widen internal R2004 extended-length arithmetic and clip by remaining output capacity.
Keep checks fast and generated-input-only; do not add external drawings or promote support claims.

localFinding.mechanism: longCompressionOffset and litLength18 returned uint32_t; an extended length, including the long-copy opcode bias, could exceed UINT32_MAX and wrap before output-window clipping.

generatedControl.expectedClippedBackReference: repeat the final literal byte through the remaining output window
cases: extended long-copy token clipped to a 64-byte output window
extended initial literal length clipped to a 64-byte output window

changes: Use uint64_t for R2004 long compression offsets, literal lengths, and decompression copy/literal counters.
Compare extended copy/literal lengths against outputSize - outputCursor before clipping, avoiding cursor-plus-length overflow.
Add a generated in-memory AC1018 regression to the existing focused decompressor test owner.
implementation.preFixRuntimeComparison: Not performed with the finalized generated controls; old wrapped values are recorded from direct source arithmetic.

limitations: The controls validate local decompressor arithmetic only; they are not producer-derived DWG witnesses or a complete security audit.
The output-window clipping behavior is tested at the decompressor boundary, not through a full malformed-file transaction/publication test.
